facts.fact: Digital Transition Minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabane told parliament her department is finalising three major projects: the Djam platform, a chatbot on electronic communications regulation and a chatbot on Burkina Faso's legislative texts.
facts.system: Djam platform; chatbots on communications regulation and legislative texts

BFA.note: The named AI projects are general-administration chatbots, not a sector's public system.

facts.fact: The minister said the PACDIGITAL project, run by the Ministry of Digital Transition, provides substantial funding to set up AI centres of excellence and study grants.

BFA.note: No government online service, portal or count is named.

facts.fact: Minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabane told parliament the national backbone now offers robust connectivity across the whole territory.
